However, the WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that the "1887" date mentioned in the snippets referred to an alliance. In reality, 1887 marks the year diplomatic relations were established (or a treaty of amity), not a military alliance. An alliance implies a formal pact for mutual defense or joint action in war, which Thailand and Japan signed in December 1941. By confusing "diplomatic relations" with "alliance," the agent has derived an incorrect answer (1887 instead of 1941), derailing the problem-solving process.
